blocks.text: These two Names are found in the Prophetic sunnah. In the Sunan and in the Musnad of Imaam Ahmad Anas bin Maalik said, when prices were high in al-Madeenah at the time of Allaah's Messenger ﷺ the people said,

'O Allaah's Messenger! Prices have become high so fix them for us'. Allaah's Messenger ﷺ replied, 'Allaah is the One who fixes prices, Who withholds, gives lavishly and provides. And I hope that when I meet Allaah, the Most High, none of you will have any claim on me for an injustice regarding blood or property.'
blocks.ref: Sunan Abi Dawood no. 3451; at-Tirmidhee no. 1314; Ibn Maajah no. 2200; Musnad Ahmad 3/156 and others with a sound chain

blocks.text: Al-Baasit The Granter of extensive provision means the One who extends His provision to whomever He wishes of His servants.
Al-Qaabid means the One who restricts or withholds His provisions from whomever He wishes out of what Allaah sees as being of benefit to the servants.
And if Allah were to enlarge the provision for His slaves, they would surely rebel in the earth, but He sends down by measure as He wills.

'Al-Qabd' is restricting provision and 'al-bast' is expanding and increasing it. Both of them are in Allaah's Hand so He is Al-Qaabid and Al-Baasit, the One who debases and raises, the One who gives and withholds, the One who gives honour and humiliates, He has no partner.
Extending and withholding provision is attributed to Allaah in many of the texts found in the Book and Sunnah. Allaah said,

Allah increases the provision for whom He wills, and straitens (it for whom He wills), and they rejoice in the life of the world, whereas the life of this world as compared with the Hereafter is but a brief passing enjoyment.
Truly, your Lord enlarges the provision for whom He wills and straitens (for whom He wills). Verily, He is Ever All-Knower, All-Seer of His slaves.

These texts and others like them prove that extending and withholding provision is all in Allaah's Hand. He can manage it and dispose of it. He extends provision to whomever He wills regarding his wealth, health, age, knowledge and life. He also withholds provision as He is the All-Wise, the All-Aware.
O Allaah increase us in Your blessings, mercy, grace and provision!

keyPoints: Al-Qaabid and Al-Baasit are found in the Prophetic sunnah, in the hadeeth of Anas: "Allaah is the One who fixes prices, Who withholds, gives lavishly and provides."
Al-Baasit means the One who extends His provision to whomever He wishes of His servants.
Al-Qaabid means the One who restricts or withholds His provisions from whomever He wishes out of what Allaah sees as being of benefit to the servants.
'Al-Qabd' is restricting provision and 'al-bast' is expanding and increasing it; both are in Allaah's Hand alone, He has no partner.
Allaah extends provision to whomever He wills in wealth, health, age, knowledge and life, and withholds it as He is the All-Wise, the All-Aware.

evidence.text: 'Allaah is the One who fixes prices, Who withholds, gives lavishly and provides.'
evidence.ref: Sunan Abi Dawood no. 3451; at-Tirmidhee no. 1314; Musnad Ahmad 3/156

evidence.text: And if Allah were to enlarge the provision for His slaves, they would surely rebel in the earth, but He sends down by measure as He wills.

recall.a: The Withholder: the One who restricts or withholds His provisions from whomever He wishes out of what Allaah sees as being of benefit to the servants.
The Granter of extensive provision: the One who extends His provision to whomever He wishes of His servants.

recall.q: On what occasion did the Prophet ﷺ say 'Allaah is the One who fixes prices, Who withholds, gives lavishly and provides'?
recall.a: When prices were high in al-Madeenah and the people asked him to fix prices for them (narrated by Anas bin Maalik).

recall.q: Which aayah explains why Allaah does not enlarge provision for all His slaves?
recall.a: "And if Allah were to enlarge the provision for His slaves, they would surely rebel in the earth, but He sends down by measure as He wills." [Shooraa 42:27]
